display: Dance Arena V2 — package build overrides
_comment: Workspace packages are consumed FROM SOURCE by typecheck and by the Vite/electron-vite
bundlers (see the 'exports' field of each package.json).
'pnpm build' additionally compiles every package standalone with tsc so that each one is
provably compilable on its own, against the *emitted declarations* of its dependencies.
pnpm runs recursive scripts in topological order, so dependencies are always built first.
